question: In which of the following states is the Nahargarh Fort located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nahargarh Fort located at **Rajasthan.**

 
• The Nahargarh Fort is proudly on a ridge of the Aravalli hills, which forms an impressive northern backdrop for the city of Jaipur.
 
• It was constructed during the reign of Jai Singh in 1734 and later expanded in **1868.**
 
• Nahargarh, meaning the abode of tigers, was a formidable blocker protecting Jaipur against attacking enemies.
 
• Jaipur is the capital of Rajasthan is popularly known as the Pink City.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Chittorgarh Fort**
 
 
 
• It is located in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan.
 
• It was constructed by Chitrangad Mori of the Maurya dynasty.
 
• Bappa Rawal, the founder of the Mewar Dynasty made Chittorgarh his capital.
 
• It is one of the biggest forts in India.
 
• It was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2013. 
 
 
 
 

 **Kumbhalgarh Fort**
 It is located in Kumbhalgarh, Rajasthan.
 
 
• This fort has the second-largest wall after the Great Wall of China.
 
• It was built by Rana Kumbha in the 15th century.
 
• It was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2013.
 
 
 
 

 **Ranthambore Fort**
 
 
 
• This fort lies within the Ranthambore National Park, Jaipur, Rajasthan
 
• It was declared as UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2013.
 
 
 
 

 **Jhalawar Fort /Gagron Fort**
 
 
 
• It is located in the Jhalawar district, Rajasthan.
 
• It was built by Maharaj Rana Madan Singh
 
• It was declared as UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2013.
 
 
 
 

 **Jaipur Fort**
 
 
 
• It is also known as Amer Fort
 
• It is located in the Amer district, Rajasthan.
 
• Its construction was started by Raja Man Singh.
 
• It was declared as UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2013.
 
 
 
 

 **Jaisalmer Fort**
 
 
 
• It is located in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan.
 
• It was built by Rawal Jaisal in the 11th century.
 
• It was declared as UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2013.
